wholePhysicalScope: Native named tower Q4850503 and the contiguous surveyed curtain and path. The parent independently matches Tsarevets Q512147. Source terrain supplies the grade across the headland, and public-domain photography supplies the visible tower and wall forms.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the tower, cantilevered battlements, exterior stairs and mapped curtain ends.
limitations: The tower and immediately adjoining curtain are modeled. The northern and western castle circuit, skyline church, and other foundations belong to the wider site.
The standing profile follows the surviving photograph and mapped footprint. Precise stonework, door and stair details, wall top grades and close cliff footing are approximations.
